title: Delivery entrance
passage: Which entrance should the courier use? A. A package for the director. B. It arrived before lunch. C. The side door next to the loading bay.
passageZh:
快遞員應該使用哪個入口？
A. 一件給主管的包裹。
B. 它在午餐前到了。
C. 卸貨區旁的側門。
audioScript: Which entrance should the courier use? A. A package for the director. B. It arrived before lunch. C. The side door next to the loading bay.
